page.notes: The margin notes "Cap.5." and "Cap.13." were printed in the right margin; they are placed where they stand. Catchword "nè fu-" and signature "N 2" are at the foot. The text has been transcribed with u/v and long-s rules applied; the printed spelling "cofenfu" was read as "cosensu" and "liberaffe" as "liberasse", both on the s-as-s rule, and could be checked against the scan. The printed "uen triculi" is read as "ventriculi". The printed text continues onto the next page with "nè fu-".
